messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Increased 5xx and model output corruption rate on serving-pool-a (model: rw-llama-large, region: us-west). Error spike started ~2369012200. Investigate. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/serving-pool-a/errors

dave_oncall: acknowledging, paging oncall. I'm on it — pulling traces and traffic heatmap now. @sylvia_eng @maria_sre please standby. :pager:

sylvia_eng: grabbing logs. seeing a pattern: a subset of requests shows KV cache returns whose seq_offset doesn't match request context length. looks like reused KV entries from previous requests. minimal reproduction in logs below.

simon_ml: past incidents pointed to KV reuse when continuous batching + fast worker recycling is enabled. Could be a cache key collision or missing tenant binding. Sharing debug snippet from prod logs:

```
[2026-03-15T12:30:05Z] req=abcd123 model=rw-llama-large worker=pool-a-17 kv_hit=true kv_key="kv::model:rw-llama-large::slice:42" kv_seq_offset=40 expected_seq_offset=0
[2026-03-15T12:30:05Z] req=abcd123 generation_start seq_offset_mismatch=true reuse_from_req=req=xyzt999
[2026-03-15T12:30:05Z] output=<<tokens garbled, partial tokens from previous request>>
```

simon_ml: note the kv_key doesn't include tenant_id in some cases (older pooling path). That would let entries carry across requests if worker reused cache slot.

maria_sre: confirmed customer reports: 3 different customers have reported garbled completions / token leakage. magnitude small (~0.05% of requests) but high severity for data correctness/security. We're paged.

dave_oncall: scope: affects continuous-batching enabled workers in pool-a, primarily rw-llama-large and rw-llama-medium variants. Impact window: ~12:30-12:52 UTC so far. Immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable continuous batching for impacted model variants, 2) apply a patch to include tenant_id+req_id in KV cache keys, 3) purge suspect KV entries from hot nodes, 4) notify customers and open P0.

sylvia_eng: I'm going to push a config hotfix to routing policy to set continuous_batching=false for rw-llama-large on pool-a and adjust max_batch_size to 1 as stopgap. Will run canary then rollout.

```
# stopgap via rictl (redwood infra cli)
rictl routing update --pool pool-a --model rw-llama-large --set continuous_batching=false,max_batch_size=1 --reason "KV reuse correctness incident hotfix"
```

sylvia_eng: applying canary to 10% workers now.

(incident-bot): Deploy job started: canary routing patch (job 8421). Tracking: https://deploys.internal/job/8421

sylvia_eng: canary metrics look good — error rate for canary workers dropped to baseline within 2 minutes. rolling to 100%.

maria_sre: running cache purge on hot nodes (pool-a-15..pool-a-20). Command:

```
ssh prometheus@pool-a-15 -- sudo /opt/redwood/bin/kv_cache_tool --purge --model rw-llama-large
```

dave_oncall: adding an extra guard: enable seq_offset check in runtime so any kv_hit where kv_seq_offset != expected -> fallback to cold load and log. pushing quick patch.

```
# runtime guard (hotfix)
apply_patch runtime/kv_cache.cpp <<'PATCH'
- if (kv_hit) { use_cache(); }
+ if (kv_hit) {
+   if (kv.seq_offset != expected_seq_offset) { log.warn("kv_seq_mismatch", ...); fallback_to_cold(); }
+   else { use_cache(); }
+ }
PATCH

rictl deploy --pool pool-a --image redwood/runtime:hotfix-kvseq-20260315
```

simon_ml: good. also adding tenant_id to key generation in a separate rolling patch (will go through CI, aiming high priority today).

product-ops: drafting customer comms summary. customers impacted: cust-omega, cust-lumen, cust-arc (three reported). asking security: any evidence of PII exfil? we observed token fragments from prior requests, but we haven't confirmed full PII exposure.

customer-ops: sending initial heads-up to the three customers: short outage window, mitigation steps, and we're investigating. template sent.

maria_sre: metrics update after full rollout of routing change + runtime hotfix: overall error rate back to baseline in 7 minutes. Garbage outputs no longer reproducing on canary or full pool.

dave_oncall: timeline so far: 12:30 alert -> 12:34 page ack -> 12:38 canary routing patch -> 12:42 canary good -> 12:45 purge & runtime hotfix -> 12:52 full rollout complete. Total customer visible window ~22 minutes. Will mark incident as active and do postmortem.

jacob_ps: I'm taking postmortem. tagging owners: simon_ml (root cause analysis), sylvia_eng (hotfix + rollout), maria_sre (operational cleanup + monitoring), product-ops (customer comms).

sylvia_eng: next steps immediate (1-3 days): add tenant_id to every kv cache key, add seq_offset assertion in unit tests, add integration test that simulates fast worker recycle + continuous batching to reproduce. Longer term: redesign pooling key space and strict cache isolation per-request.

simon_ml: probable root cause: a race where the old pooling path constructed a compact cache key that omitted tenant_id under load, combined with continuous batching reuse path that didn't reset seq_offset on worker handoff. combination allowed stale KV entries with mismatched seq_offset to be reused across requests. will put detailed root cause in postmortem.

incident-bot: Pager acknowledged by dave_oncall, incident declared P0, severity=high. Incident channel: #incidents. Incident doc: https://incidents.internal/2369012345

dave_oncall: handing off to maria_sre for follow-up and remediation tracking. I'll be available for questions but un-paging now.

maria_sre: taking ownership for remediation tracking and postmortem writeup. I'll include a timeline, impact, root cause, and a changelog of hotfixes. Blocking items: engineering patch for tenant_id key change (priority), add runtime seq checks to mainline, add alert for increased kv_seq_mismatch logs.

product-ops: Customer follow-ups: scheduled 1:1 with cust-omega security team at 16:00 UTC. will include compliance summary and mitigation steps.

jacob_ps: assigning postmortem to 2369-kw-incident board. Expected draft by EOD tomorrow.

(incident-bot): Update: incident status -> mitigated. Please confirm when postmortem is filed and follow-ups complete. :white_check_mark:

maria_sre: confirmed mitigated. filing interim notes and will attach logs/graphs to postmortem. Closing this thread for active paging. Thanks everyone for quick responses."
